fixture_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact bytes from git ls-tree -rz HEAD. Every tracked working file is independently compared with its Git blob, including executable mode. Git administrative metadata is excluded from the content hash.
description: Unmeasured replacement for the invalidated fabricated campaign's fixture/questions. This manifest records a reproducible content seal, not proof that G0-G5 passed.

isolation.agent_root: Only the verified PostgreSQL checkout is visible to either agent.
isolation.agent_question_input: Objective and scheduling metadata only, loaded from postgres-questions.json.
isolation.evaluator_only: postgres-expected-answers.json must remain outside both agent roots and all agent prompts.
isolation.transfer_pairing: Evaluator-only transfer_pairs maps each of the first ten requests to one distinct neighboring request in the last ten.
isolation.memory: Reset CodeTour memory between R and T; preserve it within each series, including transfer priming. Count all ten priming requests.

seal.rule: Verify this content seal and checkout before every run. Replacement hashes must be registered by the integration owner at G5 before measurement; any later mutation blocks the campaign.

limitations: The validator checks source integrity, scoped direct call syntax and citations; semantic claims still require independent blind evaluation.
Filesystem mode checks require no write bits on checkout files, directories and Git metadata. The runner must also restrict agent access to a shared read-only checkout.
No live campaign or benchmark gains are asserted by this manifest.
